title: 2026 Raku Workshops
source_quote: 2026 Raku Workshops... Dates: June 19 (rain date June 20) July 11 (rain date July 12) September 12 (rain date Sept 13) 10:00am-4:00pm
evidence_sentence: The workshop page lists three scheduled 2026 raku firing workshop dates where participants bring bisque-fired pieces and learn traditional and alternative raku techniques.
evidence_quote: Experience the excitement of Raku Firing in our hands-on workshop. Discover the unique process of this traditional Japanese inspired technique
summary: One-day raku workshops on June 19, July 11, and September 12, 2026. Bring bisque-fired pots and learn traditional raku glazes, naked raku, horse hair, and obvara techniques. $175 per participant. Contact to book.
bring: Bisque-fired pots (bisque fire range 08-05), terra sigillata (optional), own raku glazes optional, long-sleeved natural fiber shirt, closed-toe shoes, camp chair, snacks/drinks/lunch
how_to_join: Book at https://www.lukeiannuzzipottery.com/booking-calendar/2026-raku-workshops or contact via phone 802-839-9650 or email lukeiannuzzipottery@gmail.com
